title: A brick stable behind 1638 Prairie
items: The alley behind 1638 Prairie now has its two-storey brick stable, the last building on the north-west alley still standing as a rough draft: 11 m along the alley and 10.5 m deep, with a fire wall to the south and a ground-floor window in its north gable over the neighbour's yard. Its outline, storeys, brick and window places come from the 1911 Sanborn sheet, and Robinson's 1886 atlas shows the same crossed brick stable on the lot, so it stood through 1904. The doors, loft hatch, other windows and roof come from the shared coach-house kit and are reconstructed.
